name: Product Info
summary: Passive product identity, canonical Price, rich description, and truthful product-level or selected-variant metadata projection under one target coordinator.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive product information container; the target chooses whether its page context warrants a sectioning element.

anatomy.name: identity
anatomy.description: Identity cluster containing the optional vendor, required title, and optional subtitle.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible product title rendered at the native heading rank required by the target context.

anatomy.name: price
anatomy.description: Required slot wrapper containing one canonical Price composition.

anatomy.name: meta
anatomy.description: Product metadata description list containing one or more complete name-value groups.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive content with no component-owned interaction state.

behavior.name: contextualHeading
behavior.description: The target renders one visible native title heading at the correct rank for the surrounding page or overlay; Product Info does not expose a decorative heading-level switch.

behavior.name: priceComposition
behavior.description: The required slot wrapper renders one canonical Price dependency. Product Info does not parse, format, calculate, or validate monetary data.

behavior.name: richDescription
behavior.description: The optional description preserves target-owned semantic headings, paragraphs, lists, links, emphasis, language, and direction instead of flattening rich content into one string.

behavior.name: metadataSemantics
behavior.description: Metadata uses one native description list with one or more complete localized name-value groups.

behavior.name: optionalContent
behavior.description: Targets omit optional parts and wrappers when their content is blank and never render an empty metadata list.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: Identity, rich content, and metadata wrap from the component's available inline size without viewport-specific DOM or reading-order changes.

behavior.name: truthfulProjection
behavior.description: Before variant resolution, targets may project a formatted product Price range and truthful product-level metadata only. After resolution, canonical Price plus SKU, inventory, and availability represent the exact selected variant. The data attribute is target diagnostics, not neutral configuration.

behavior.name: passiveUpdateBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Product Info adds no focus, keyboard model, listener, observer, request, formatter, timer, live region, or controlled state. One page or Quick View coordinator atomically owns variant resolution, Product Gallery, Product Info, Product Form, URL, structured data, and at most one localized update status outside this component.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible product title. Heading rank remains target-contextual.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Optional editorial subtitle or edition note.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Required slot containing one canonical Price composition supplied with a target-formatted product range before resolution or the exact selected-variant value afterward.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional target-owned semantic rich product description.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Optional native description-list composition containing complete localized product-level groups and, only after resolution, exact selected-variant SKU, inventory, and availability groups.

accessibility: Render one visible native title heading at the correct level for the target context; do not add a redundant ARIA name to the root or title.
Render metadata as a native description list with complete grouped dt/dd pairs, and omit the list when it has no pairs.
Preserve semantic headings, paragraphs, lists, links, emphasis, language, and text direction in target-supplied rich description content.
Use an appropriate known direction or dir=auto for unknown plaintext identity and scalar metadata values; canonical Price isolates formatted values with bdi.
Keep Product Info out of the tab order. Interactive descendants supplied by rich content retain their own native names, focus, and keyboard behavior.
Do not communicate price, availability, inventory, status, or variant changes by color alone, and let the owning target provide at most one deliberate localized update announcement.
Keep that update status outside Product Info so the passive component and canonical Price do not create duplicate announcements.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and semantic markup contract require no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Dedicated Liquid accepts product-level or exact selected-variant projection. Merchant-reorderable Main Product blocks and one Section Rendering API coordinator update media, Price, SKU, inventory, availability, form, URL, structured data, and one status without serializing the variant catalogue.

react.notes: Shared Exhibit/Studio renderer proves the passive exact-variant projection. Framework product-page or Quick View parents own resolution, contextual heading rank, rich nodes, atomic dependent updates, and one announcement.

figma.notes: Visual anatomy only; target heading rank, CMS trust, data, and live updates remain annotations.
